user.title: Connect to Caleffi CODE
user.description: Sign in with your Caleffi CODE account. Email and password are stored in Home Assistant and are used only to renew the session when the token expires.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Caleffi CODE
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the email and password again. Home Assistant stores them and uses them to request a new token when the session expires.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check the email and password.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Caleffi CODE API.
